findings.title: Dead AutoLayout still pollutes coverage reports
findings.why_it_matters: Coverage runs still instrument AutoLayout.ts and report it at 0%, so the aggregate coverage report continues to include code that this change explicitly describes as excluded from live-code coverage claims.
findings.suggested_fix: Add '!src/utils/AutoLayout.ts' to collectCoverageFrom, then rerun the coverage suite and confirm AutoLayout.ts is absent from the report.
evidence: jest.config.js:36-40 collects every src/**/*.ts file and contains no exclusion for src/utils/AutoLayout.ts.
jest.config.js:43-45 claims AutoLayout.ts is not counted as live coverage, but the full coverage run listed utils/AutoLayout.ts at 0% and included it in the utils and All files aggregates.

findings.title: LayoutEngine is not production-reachable
findings.why_it_matters: The new threshold and behavior matrix create a passing coverage signal for a class that the shipped server never imports, so they do not protect a production execution path and contradict the stated live-module scope.
findings.suggested_fix: Decide whether LayoutEngine should be wired into the production server/conversion path; if not, remove it from the six live-module coverage claim and treat it consistently with other unreachable layout implementations.
evidence: Repository-wide source search finds LayoutEngine only at its class definition in src/core/LayoutEngine.ts; every import and construction is under tests/.
package.json exports only dist/server/index.js, whose import graph starts at src/server/index.ts and does not import LayoutEngine.
jest.config.js:77-82 nevertheless adds LayoutEngine.ts as one of the production-reachable per-file thresholds.

residual_risks: The full coverage command passed all 31 suites and the six new thresholds, but ts-jest emitted a non-fatal TS1343 failure while collecting src/server/index.ts; that pre-existing out-of-scope warning means the aggregate report is not fully complete.
testing_gaps: No automated check verifies that modules labeled production-reachable by coverage configuration are actually reachable from the shipped server entry point.
